Below that, add a third centered text box with 'Using one training sample' in the same font, bold italic, ~26pt, color #1A1ACC. 6. In the top-right corner inside the gray panel, draw a small oval (~0.55in wide, ~0.35in tall), fill #FFFF99, outline #6633CC (1pt), and add the text '26' in black, ~12pt, centered. 7. Leave all remaining gray space empty; do not add bullets, images, or charts. 8. Optionally note (but do not draw) the mouse cursor visible in the source video near the top-center, as it is a recording artifact.
